terms.title: Terms of use and community charter
terms.version: Working draft of {date}, to be approved before opening to the public.

charter.title: The charter
charter.respect: We treat others with respect, whatever their country, language or level.
charter.abuse: No harassment, hate speech, scams or spam, in messages or in voice rooms.
charter.code: In a challenge, the code you submit is your own. The mentor helps you learn, not with the solution.
charter.honesty: Level and experience must be declared honestly: the mentor badge depends on them.

moderation.title: What we do when there is a problem
moderation.text: Every member can report a profile, a message, a conversation, an invitation or a room, and block someone. The KABAD team reviews reports: it can dismiss them, remove a message, close a room, warn or suspend an account. Every decision is recorded.

data.title: Your data
data.kept: We keep what the service needs: your profile, your messages, your pairings, your solutions and your test reports.
data.account: From “My account”, you can download all your data and delete your account at any time.

prizes.title: Hackathons and their prizes
prizes.text: Each organizer sets their own prizes, or none, and hands them out to the winners themselves: KABAD neither collects nor pays out any money. Prizes follow the jury’s ranking. The jury is made up of three verified mentors; a juror never scores someone they mentor.
